Questions and answers

What is Registrazione audio plancia?

In this glossary, Registrazione audio plancia refers to: Continuous audio recording of all conversations and alarms on the bridge as mandated by SOLAS for investigation and safety compliance.

How is Registrazione audio plancia used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Assicurarsi che il sistema di registrazione audio plancia sia operativo e registri tutte le comunicazioni, allarmi e ordini di plancia secondo il regolamento SOLAS."

Registrazione audio plancia matters because it supports clear communication in Nav contexts for Deck Officers, Engine Officers, and Masters. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as STCW, Marlins Test, ISF Watchkeeper, and GMDSS.
